agent_explanation: Actuated controller shortens yellow below yellow_seconds. With actuated=true, EW yellow lasts only 3 s (steps 202-204) before transitioning to all-red at step 205, violating the required 5 s. With actuated=false (fixed-time) the same timing parameters produce a full 5 s yellow and no violation, indicating the actuated logic incorrectly truncates or miscounts the yellow interval (likely applying gap-out/max-green termination to the yellow phase).
